deadline.value: Physics takes fall applications by January 8, earlier than the Graduate School's Feb. 1.

gre_subject.value: Physics does not require the GRE, and a Physics GRE Subject score is not considered.
gre_subject.quote: Our program does NOT require GRE scores and lack of a physics GRE subject score will not influence your application at all.

gre_general.value: The department does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: Our program does NOT require GRE scores

supervisor.value: Applications go to the admissions committee; students join a research group after their first year.
supervisor.quote: Applications are reviewed by our graduate admissions committee after the January 8 deadline.

funding.value: Admitted students receive full financial support as a teaching or research assistantship unless they choose to self-fund.
funding.quote: We offer full financial support to admitted students unless they indicate they would like to attend on their own funds.

entry_route.value: The physics pages do not say whether a bachelor's or master's is required.

notes: Department deadline (Jan 8) is earlier than the Graduate School's Feb. 1, so the department date is used. Physics GRE not considered.
